body:
Fixes #817 (AGG-R14). Owner decision (Travis, 2026-10-15): the key guard ignores only keys that arrive before a prompt is drawn or within 1 s of it, never blocks a deliberate Enter afterwards, and asks for ↑/↓ first only when keys really were dropped for that prompt. Type-ahead still never answers a new prompt (#787).

**What was wrong:** the child's command prompt, shown when the parent's `wait_agent_v1` question was answered, refused an Enter pressed 11 s later and only then said "This is a new request. Choose an option with ↑/↓, then enter". Besides #787's 1-second guard, older rules (#523, #544, #192, #514) made every revealed, replaced or held-back prompt wait for an arrow key, with no time limit.

**Change**
- A prompt coming on screen relies only on the bottom pane's 1-second guard (#787): a new request, the next one of a queue, one revealed when the view above it closes, one held back while you typed, the next question or the unanswered-questions check of a form, the app link's next screen, and the approval after its grant review. Keys before it is drawn or in the second after are dropped (each dropped key restarts the second); after that Enter answers the highlighted option.
- "Keys pressed as this request appeared were ignored" (↑/↓ first) shows only when keys were dropped for that prompt; keys dropped for an earlier prompt don't carry over.
- Screens that appear inside an open prompt take a new shown generation, so the guard covers them too.
- Unchanged: typed text and pasted text never answer a prompt; options that last beyond the request are chosen only with ↑/↓; held keys never confirm; Esc and keys are dropped in the first second; Ctrl+C acts at once. What runs and what is denied is unchanged at every level, Permissive included.
- Removed: `FreshChoice`, `require_fresh_choice*`, `require_deliberate_choice`, `last_view_closed_at`, `Notice::ChooseFirst`.

**Tests:** `tui/src/bottom_pane/tests/issue_817.rs` (the AGG-R14 sequence with an Enter 11 s later; every arrival × exec, question and MCP approval: Enter after the guard answers, type-ahead within it is dropped; keys dropped for an earlier prompt don't hold the next; typing across a request swap; the link confirmation screen). Fail-before on main: all 4 first tests fail. Older tests that asserted the timing-free block were moved to guarded panes with explicit times or now assert the new shown generation.

**Gate evidence:** see the comment below (updated on the final head).
title: Prompts take a deliberate Enter once their first second passes (#817)
